entities.summary: Haeju Oh clan is a Korean clan. Their Bon-gwan is in Haeju, Hwanghae Province. As of 2000, the clan has a membership of 422,735. Their founder was Oh In yu, who was the governor of Haeju county during the era of Goryeo.
